title: Check
description: A machine check a step declares on its result, taken from a fixed catalogue (UC-4.13, ADR-0082). The class `exact` is a claim that a check makes the value right; the check names how. Each kind is one row of the catalogue and takes exactly the parameters that row needs: reconciliation against a total (`total`, `source`), agreement with a second system (`source`, `reference`), plausibility bounds (`minimum`, `maximum`, `pattern`, at least one), approval above a threshold (`threshold`, `role`), sampling (`share`, `role`), and recomputation (none; provisional under DEC-0173). A kind outside the catalogue is a change of the catalogue, not a choice of whoever writes the process.

subject.description: What the check is applied to, in the reader's words: `the booked amount`. Without it the exactness statement says `the result`.

total.description: reconciliation: the total the parts must sum to, in the reader's words: `the invoice total`.

source.description: reconciliation: the capability through which the total is read at the moment of the check. agreement: the capability through which the second system's value is read.

reference.description: agreement: which of the two values is the reference when they differ — the step's own (`step`) or the second system's (`source`).

minimum.description: bounds: the smallest admissible value, inclusive.

maximum.description: bounds: the largest admissible value, inclusive.

pattern.description: bounds: a regular expression the whole value, as text, must match.

threshold.description: approval: a value above it is confirmed by a person of `role` before it counts.

share.description: sampling: the share of results a person of `role` checks after the fact, greater than 0 and at most 1.

role.description: approval and sampling: the role that decides. Never a named person (principle 14).
